project.name: IOT-EE Platform :: architecture
project.description:
Shared ArchUnit rule DEFINITIONS only (ADR 0013 Decision 8): reusable ArchRule factory methods and import-scoping helpers that every services/* module's own architecture test calls with its own package roots and its own local negative-test fixtures. This module contains no business logic, no domain classes, no Spring components, and no helper implementation that runs at application runtime -- everything here executes only during `mvn test`/`mvn verify`, never inside a running service.
CONSUMED AT TEST SCOPE ONLY. This is the one artifact ADR 0013 permits any services/* or adapters/* module to depend on, and only because it never ships in a runtime artifact. The parent pom's enforce-no-shared-runtime Maven Enforcer rule bans a compile- or runtime-scope dependency on this artifact (or any other com.iotee.platform:* artifact) -- a consumer must declare <scope>test</scope> explicitly, exactly the way services/identity/pom.xml does.
This module has no ArchUnit rules of its own (there is no business logic here to check boundaries on) and depends only on ArchUnit and JUnit -- both ordinary third-party testing libraries, not project-authored runtime code, per ADR 0013 Decision 2.
